headline: OLD IMPAIRMENTS
CAN COME BACK

blocks.text: Forming a Tax Group wipes out old intra-group items.

items: Loss deducted **before** the group was formed.
At formation, the loan is **not eliminated** in the AFS.
A later **reversal is taxable**, up to the loss deducted.
